# Review finding: legacy-shape read fallback removed before migration completes (P0)

Pattern: a "cleanup" removes the dual-shape reader branch (legacy top-level `address` vs nested `destination.address`) while background migration is still bounded/incremental and no startup gate guarantees completion. Legacy rows then raise KeyError; in list endpoints built via comprehension (api.list_destinations), one legacy row fails the entire response.

Detection: diff removes an `if "<new_key>" in row` / fallback branch in a reader; README or data snapshot (data/records.json) documents mixed shapes as supported; migrate_batch has a limit and no caller/gate.

Rule: keep compatibility readers until a verifiable precondition (zero legacy rows in all stores) is enforced. Add a mixed-snapshot test so removal fails CI.

Source: /kk:review-code:isolated on reader.py address_of, 2026-10-11.
